ceilingBeams.note: Geometry-extracted 2026-07-29 by tools/glb-prep/extract-beams.mjs, replacing a hand transcription read off the HalfCoupler clamps. Eleven ⌀7cm tubes run along y at 405cm pitch, x = 158 + 405k, height 909–916cm. NOTHING runs along x at beam height. The 72 HalfCoupler clamps are 36 hand-placed hanging light fixtures (9 columns × 4 rows) clamped to those tubes; their centres sit ~17cm to the +x of the tube they hold, which is exactly where the previous numbers came from.
ceilingBeams.heightNote: tube spans 909–916, centre 912.5; 910 is inside it
ceilingBeams.alongXNote: NOT extractable — nothing runs along x at beam height in this model. These three are the real truss as given by the venue owner 2026-07-29: 6.02m pitch, 1.02m off the wall, and 102+602+602+102 = 1408 closes exactly on the roofed bay. The GLB instead yields 190/550/904/1270, which are the 4 rows of the 36 hanging fixtures (measured to <0.5cm) and are recorded here only as measurement.
ceilingBeams.diagonals: none in the model; 14.PNG shows them on the real truss but they were never modelled
ceilingBeams.trussColorNote: baseColorFactor [0.725,0.635,0.533] with NO baseColor texture, so the factor is the colour. Use the sRGB form in code (three converts sRGB→linear and lands back on the glTF value); the linear hex would render too light. Identified two ways: every slender member at truss height carries this material, and exactly 9 of them (matching the 9-beam grid) pass through clamp crossings.

source.skpModifiedNote: venue.glb itself is still the 2026-07-28 19:47 build and is CORRECT — see venueGlbNotRebuilt. The zone rectangles in venuePacks.ts were re-extracted on 2026-07-29 from a fresh export of the 16:25 save.
source.zoneExtractionNote: ⚠ extract-zones.mjs CANNOT run on venue.glb — glb-prep strips the ZONE_* marker faces, so it exits with 'no ZONE_FLOOR found'. It must be pointed at the RAW SimLab export. Those live outside the repo in D:/simlab-out/ and are not kept forever: the 19:47 one this asset was built from is already gone. Producing a new one is a single MCP call and takes about a minute — simlab_convert(skp -> D:/simlab-out/raw-venue-<stamp>.glb) — which is how the 2026-07-29 numbers were obtained. Re-export rather than trust an old raw file.
source.venueGlbNotRebuilt: MEASURED, not assumed. Structural fingerprint of raw-venue-1803.glb vs a fresh export of the 16:25 save: triangles 3217110 in BOTH, world bounds identical to 3 decimals ([-8.546,-1.45,-32.392]..[75.65,11.623,1.139]), 59 materials, 28 textures in both. The ONLY differences are node 9893->9890, mesh/primitive 4451->4450, and the triangle counts of two marker materials, ZONE_POOL 20->10 and ZONE_SAVIV 4->14 — which sum to 24 on both sides. Every edit the user made since 18:03 was confined to ZONE_* marker faces and touched no visible geometry, so the committed venue.glb still renders the right building and section.json cut from it is still valid.
changesFromPreviousImport: ZONE_SAVIV is TWO SHAPES belonging to one zone — the area where the user is allowed to stand the vegetation (plant.potted). It is one GLB primitive (3DGeom-32408, 14 triangles) holding two disjoint connected components; SketchUp merged the two painted faces because they share a material and parent group. Each shape is an L, not a rectangle, so the pair is four rectangles: west 766,1408,1043x203 + 766,1611,123x933 (32.65 m²), east 2579,1408,1383x203 + 3839,1611,123x933 (39.55 m²). Total 72.20 m², matching the painted area exactly.

The 18:03 file carried saviv as 2579,1408,1383x1136. That is precisely the BOUNDING BOX of the east shape, which was the only shape then. The pool overlap everyone was looking at was never a drawing error — it was one L-shape reported as its box. At 19:47 the user added the west shape, and bounding both together gives 766,1408,3196x1136, which is why the zone looked like it had swallowed the pool.

ZONE_POOL REDRAWN to the water alone: one face, 10 triangles, bbox x 889 y 1611 2950x933, 87.1% fill — the water bitten out around the chuppah podium. Previously x 766 y 1408 3073x1136. The north and west apron that used to be inside pool moved out into saviv's west shape.

THE RENDERED MODEL IS UNCHANGED. venue.glb rebuilt from the 19:47 save compares structurally identical to the 18:03 build: 9860 nodes, 351 meshes, 44 materials, 18 textures, 4438 primitives, 3217047 triangles, identical world bounds, and an identical per-material triangle distribution. pastedIntoCode: All five rectangles are now in src/core/venuePacks.ts: pool as 889,1611,2950x933 and saviv as its four. Multiple rectangles under one kind are already supported — the clamp does zones.filter(z => z.kind === zoneKind) and snaps to the nearest by centre distance (actions.ts:348-382), and collision tests membership with .some() (collision.ts:456).

saviv is kept as four exact rectangles rather than two per-shape bounding boxes. It is a PERMISSIVE region, so over-claiming is the dangerous direction: the two boxes would be 1043x1136 and 1383x1136 and would cover 203.39 m² of the pool's 275.24 m², i.e. permit plants standing in the water. The four exact rectangles cover 0 m² of it. pool is the opposite case — it FORBIDS, so its bounding box errs safe and stays one rectangle.
Shrinking pool was a PREREQUISITE, not an option: at its old 766,1408,3073x1136 it contained all four saviv rectangles, so any plant would have drawn forbiddenZone:pool no matter what PLAN-06 does.

Verified numerically: the four saviv rectangles sum to 72.20 m² (the measured paint), and saviv's intersection with pool, with itself, with chuppah and with both DJ pads is 0 m² in every case. chuppah remains fully inside pool.

notImported: ZONE_FLOR — the flooring zone of source doc §20 ('a flooring ZONE belonging only to the reception'). NOT IN THE MODEL. Measured two independent ways on the 2026-07-29 16:25 save: the GLB export declares 59 materials of which exactly ten contain 'zone' (BAR, CHUPPAH, CORRIDOR, DANCEFLOOR, DJ, FLOOR, HUPA, KABALAT_PANIM, POOL, SAVIV), and a raw byte scan of the .skp itself finds ten distinct ZONE_ tokens and zero occurrences of the string ZONE_FLOR. No rectangle was invented. extract-zones.mjs already maps ZONE_FLOR -> kind 'flooring', label 'ריצוף', so the day the face is painted it lands with no code change. ⚠ ZONE_FLOR (one O) is the flooring marker; ZONE_FLOOR (two O's) is the floor OUTLINE that establishes the plan origin — one keystroke apart, entirely different meanings. See handoff/BLOCKED-01-A1.md.
